data.title: Speed challenge: readable release duration
story: The release dashboard shows durations in seconds only, for example 125. The team wants "2m 5s".
Write format_duration(seconds). Use // for minutes (whole division) and % for the leftover seconds, then turn numbers into text with str().
data.solution:
def format_duration(seconds):
    minutes = seconds // 60
    rest = seconds % 60
    return str(minutes) + "m " + str(rest) + "s"

explanation: seconds // 60 gives the whole minutes and seconds % 60 gives the leftover seconds. Numbers must be turned into text with str() before joining them with +.
hints: Store the results in minutes and rest.
